prerequisites: Solid knowledge and skills in the subject area of the bachelor's thesis, as well as underlying fundamentals.

learning_outcomes.text: To apply appropriate engineering methods for the analysis of technical problems in the familiar technology field.
To analyze technical problems within the familiar technology field.
To solve technical problems using previously learned methods.
To locate relevant sources and information resources for entering new technical fields.
To find the necessary information for entry through targeted literature research.
To concisely summarize the central background of the bachelor's thesis topic.
To transfer obtained information to new technical contexts and areas.
To describe the given task professionally and comprehensibly.
To carry out the solution of the task using appropriate engineering methods.
To present results orally and in writing in an audience-appropriate manner.
To clearly formulate concise core statements.
To constructively discuss questions and feedback on the applied methods and achieved results.
To summarize content and results compactly.
To format the written elaboration according to standards.
To check one's own presentation based on defined criteria.

syllabus_topics: VO Einführung in das wissenschaftliche Arbeiten
teaching_methods: Independent writing of a bachelor's thesis under guidance
assessment_rules: The applied teaching and learning methods, as well as the examination modalities, must be specified in the information system for studies and teaching for each course before the beginning of the semester.
